attributes.mlflow.spanInputs: {"question": "I lost my 2FA device but I still have my backup codes. What do I do?"}
attributes.mlflow.spanOutputs:
"You can sign in with one of your backup codes in place of the 6-digit code from your authenticator app. Each backup code works only once, so use a fresh one if you've already used some.

Once you're signed in, you can set up your 2FA device again from your account security settings.

If you can't find a working backup code, let us know here and we'll start identity verification. That usually takes 2 business days."
